lp_title: Decision Rooms · Decide together, on facts
lp_desc: Decision Rooms helps leaders and organisations make better decisions together: grounded in facts, honest about disagreement, accountable for how they turn out.
lp_h1: Decide together, on facts, with every voice heard.
lp_sub: Bring your question, your files and what's happening in the world into one room. Everyone answers privately. AI does the heavy analysis with a proven decision model, and you get one clear call with the reasoning shown. Your group weighs in; you decide.
lp_f1_c: people is where group decisions peak
lp_f1_f: Each person beyond seven cuts decision effectiveness by about 10%. Groups of 17 or more rarely decide at all.
lp_f2_c: of leaders say their organisation excels at decision making
lp_f2_f: Most say the process is slow, political or unclear about who decides.
lp_f3_c: of leaders' time goes into making decisions
lp_f3_f: And more than half of that time, they say, is used ineffectively.
lp_f4_c: more reasons for failure surface when a team imagines it already happened
lp_f4_f: That's the idea behind the pre-mortem, which every room runs before it makes a call.
lp_f4_s: Mitchell, Russo & Pennington (1989); Gary Klein, HBR (2007)
lp_s1_b: Write the question, the options and what everyone should know. Add files if you have them.
lp_s2_b: Share one link. Each person says, in about two minutes and in private, what matters to them and how much risk they can live with.
lp_s3_b: AI weighs the options with a proven decision model, recommended for your question, against live facts and every member's view.
lp_s4_b: A recommendation with its reasons, the risks, where the group differs, and tripwires that tell you when to rethink.
lp_s5_b: The owner decides on the record, everyone signs off, and on the review date the room checks how it turned out.
lp_models_t: Proven ways of thinking, built in
lp_models_b: Every room uses a decision model from the world's best strategy teams. We recommend one for your question; you can choose another.
lp_get_b: One recommendation, the reasoning behind it, and an honest picture of where the group agrees and where it splits. Never who said what.
lp_mock_q: Should we open a second office in Dubai this year?
lp_mock_h: Wait a year and serve the Gulf remotely, while testing whether local presence is really blocking sales.
lp_mock_split: Cash risk: the group is split
lp_t1_b: Each person's answers are visible only to them, enforced in the database. The group sees the combined result, never who said what.
lp_t2_b: Your questions and files are used only to produce your decision. We never sell them or use them to train AI models. Storage is encrypted.
lp_t3_b: Public-affairs rooms decide only from the group's own stated values and show the strongest case for each side.
lp_t4_b: The recommendation supports your judgement. The owner decides, and any override is recorded with the reason.
lp_plans_b: Everything is free while we run the trial. These are the plans we'll offer after it.
lp_p1_l: Up to 8 members · 10 rooms a month · All decision models · Reviews
lp_p2_l: Several workspaces · More rooms and members · RAPID roles · Priority support
lp_p3_l: A room plus a session with a human facilitator, for succession, a partner exit or a public stance
lp_end_t: Your next big call deserves more than the loudest voice in the room.
lp_rights: Decision Rooms supports decisions; it doesn't replace professional advice.

st_title: Decision Rooms · Every group has one decision it can't make
st_desc: Bring your group into one room. Everyone gets a voice, the homework gets done, and you leave with one clear call.
st_h1: Every group has one decision it can't make.
st_sub: Six people. Five opinions. One very long WhatsApp thread. Tonight, someone finally ends it.
st_star: Starring you, your people, and one clear call.
st_a1_b: You've seen this movie before. Someone asks a simple question. Forty messages later, nobody's answered it. The loudest voice wins. The quiet one was right. Nobody remembers who said what.
st_a1_h: Groups don't fail because they're wrong. They fail because they never actually decide.
st_a2_h: A door. Light underneath. Everyone walks in.
st_a2_b: Bring the question, leave with a clear call. Everyone gets a voice. The room listens, does the homework and recommends one call. You make it.
st_r1_b: Launch, pivot, hire, walk away. The partners argue. The room brings the numbers and the blind spots.
st_r2_b: Where the money talks, and the room makes sure it isn't bluffing.
st_r3_b: Every side heard. Facts checked and dated. Opinions labelled as opinions.
st_r4_b: Ministers, advisors and the people who carry it out. Every view weighed, every fact dated, and the call on the record.
st_a3: Act III · How the scene plays out
st_s1_b: Someone opens a room and drops the question.
st_s2_b: Everyone adds what they want, what they fear and what they know, in private.
st_s3_b: The room looks for what you're all missing: live news, real data, the risk nobody wants to say out loud.
st_s4_b: One clear recommended call, the reasons and how sure it is. Then you decide.
st_cast_b: Speaks English and Arabic. Built for boards, ministries, partners and family businesses who are tired of "let's discuss later."
st_end_slug: The room goes quiet. Everyone's looking at you.
st_end_h: Somebody has to open the door.

og_memory_hint: When a room decides, the analysis looks at your organisation's earlier decisions, their reasons and how they turned out, and learns from them. Nothing is used to train any AI model.
og_memory_lbl: Use our past decisions in new analyses
og_memory_never: It reads calls, reasons and reviews only. Never anyone's private answers, and never rooms marked strictly confidential. It mentions lessons in general terms, without details from other rooms.
email_wait_secs: A code was just sent to this address. You can ask for a new one in {n} seconds, or type the code you already have.
email_wait_hour: Too many emails were sent in the last hour. Use a code you already have, or try again later.
gr_q_overview: Are more decisions being made each week?
gr_q_acquisition: Where do new accounts come from? Last 12 weeks.
gr_q_activation: Do new accounts reach their first decision? Accounts from the last 12 weeks.
gr_q_loop: Do invited people join, answer and then open rooms of their own? Last 12 weeks.
gr_q_rooms: Where do rooms stop? Rooms opened in the last 12 weeks.
gr_q_retention: Do owners come back in the weeks after their first room?
gr_q_quality: Do people trust the call, and does it hold up later?
gr_q_money: What does the AI cost, and who might need a bigger plan?
gr_q_health: Is anything broken or slow right now?
gr_unavailable: The growth numbers couldn't load. The People tab still works.
gr_north: North star · decisions made this week
gr_north_how: Rooms that reached a settled call this week. The week runs Monday to Sunday.
gr_active_how: Owners who opened a room or settled a call.
gr_new_how: Verified sign-ups (email code, Google or Microsoft).
gr_cost_dec_how: This week's AI cost divided by decisions made.
gr_src_direct: Typed the address or a bookmark
gr_visitors_note: Visitors who never sign up aren't counted here. They show in Cloudflare Web Analytics once it's switched on.
gr_days_room: Median days to the first room
gr_days_dec: Median days to the first decision
gr_l_own: Opened a room of their own
gr_viral_how: New owners in the last 30 days who first came as someone's member, per owner active the 30 days before. Above 1 means rooms bring in more owners than they need.
gr_ret_title: Owners active in each week after their first room
gr_ret_how: Each row is the week of an owner's first room. Active means they opened a room or settled a call that week.
gr_held_how: Rated 4 or 5 at review, out of {n} reviews
gr_days_decide: Median days from opening to a call
gr_calib_how: Higher confidence should hold up more often. Numbers in brackets are reviews.
gr_cost_owner: AI cost per active owner, 30 days
gr_upgrade_how: Owners in the last 30 days with a room of more than 3 people or more than 2 rooms.
gr_h_failed_how: Reopened after two failed tries, still waiting.
gr_h_limit_how: People who reached the daily analysis limit.
gr_h_stuck: Open rooms past their decide-by date
ac_no_access: This page is for the Decision Rooms team. You can ask for admin access, and an admin will look at your request.
ac_waiting: Your request has been sent. An admin will look at it, and this page opens for you once it's approved.
ac_declined: Your last request wasn't approved. You can ask again.
ac_profile_first: Finish your profile first, then ask again.
gr_q_ask: Ask anything about accounts, rooms, growth, cost or revenue. Answers come from the numbers on this page.
gr_q_revenue: How much money comes in, from whom, and what's left after AI cost? All amounts in US dollars.
ask_ph: Ask a question, like: how many decisions were made this month?
ask_empty: I couldn't find an answer in the data.
ask_failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
ask_note: It reads the admin numbers only: never private answers, room questions, emails or phone numbers. Check important figures on the tabs.
ask_ex1: How many decisions were made this week vs last week?
ask_ex2: Which countries do new accounts come from?
ask_ex3: What is our MRR and how did it change this month?
ask_ex5: What does the AI cost per decision, and is it going up?
rv_mrr_how: Active subscriptions today. Yearly plans count as a twelfth a month.
rv_margin_how: MRR minus the last 30 days of AI cost ({v})
rv_nrr_how: Last 3 months: revenue from existing customers after upgrades, downgrades and losses. Above 100% means they grow.
rv_ltv_how: Average monthly revenue divided by the monthly revenue lost.
rv_record_how: Until card payments are added, record each subscription and invoice here. To change plan, end the old subscription and add the new one on the same day.
rv_add_invoice: Add an invoice or one-off payment
rv_paid_on: Paid on (leave empty if not yet)
rv_err_no_account: No account uses that email. Choose 'Someone without an account' instead.
rv_err_need_customer: Choose who pays, or type a name.
rv_err_duplicate: That invoice number is already used.
rv_moves_how: New: first-time customers. Expansion: customers who pay more. Contraction: pay less. Lost: stopped paying. Cash: invoices paid that month.
rv_void_sure: Cancel this invoice? It stops counting as owed.
rv_days_to_pay: Customers take {n} days to pay on average.
hi_new: Your rooms are ready for you. What are you deciding next?
hi_need_1: One room is waiting for your answer. It takes about two minutes.
hi_need_n: {n} rooms are waiting for your answer. Each takes about two minutes.
hi_ready_1: A recommended call is ready for you to look at.
hi_ready_n: {n} recommended calls are ready for you to look at.
hi_stuck_1: One room could use a little push from you.
hi_stuck_n: {n} rooms could use a little push from you.
hi_quiet: Everything is moving. Nothing needs you right now.
wait_title_member_n: Thank you, {name}. Your answers are in, and they count as much as anyone's.
wait_title_owner_n: Your room is open, {name}. Now we wait for everyone's view.
wait_one_left: {n} of {total} have answered. Just one more to go.
wait_all_in: Everyone has answered. Thank you all.
v_decided_thanks: Thank you, everyone, for your honest views. Next comes the plan.
auto_nudge_lbl: Send friendly email reminders to people who haven't answered: halfway to {date}, and the day before.
join_seen_note: The person who invited you can see that you've opened this link. Your answers stay private.
na_soon: {n} of {total} have answered, and the decide-by date is {date}. A friendly nudge now helps.
dept_hint: Pick one or more. The first one you pick leads.
dept_suggested: Suggested from your question. Tap to change; the first one leads.
nt_hint: Only you can read these. Write freely, then let the analyst tidy them or find the decision in them.
nt_pick: Pick a note, or start a new one.
nt_body_ph: What's on your mind? Facts, worries, options, who should have a say…
nt_help_fail: The analyst couldn't help just now. Please try again in a moment.
nt_tidied: Tidied. Everything you wrote is still there, just clearer.
nt_delete_sure: Delete this note? It can't be brought back.
nt_make_room_hint: Opens the setup with all of this filled in. You can change anything before the room opens.
nt_demo_body:
Riyadh store is doing well. Jeddah landlord wants an answer by March.
Cash is tight until the summer. Sara thinks we should wait, Omar wants to go now.
nt_demo_q: Should we open a second store in Jeddah this year, or wait until next spring?
nt_demo_missing: The landlord's deadline isn't confirmed in writing.
No one has costed the pop-up option.
nt_demo_ctx: The Riyadh store is profitable. The Jeddah landlord wants an answer by March. Cash is tight until the summer.
nt_draft: Draft a decision in your notes
rn_hint: Only you see these: calls, side conversations, ideas. The analysis never reads them.
rn_share_sure: Add this note to what everyone in the room can see? It goes into the room's context.
